const (
	testStudentID = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	testTeacherID = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	testDialogID  = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
)

type testClock struct {
	mu  sync.Mutex
	now time.Time
}

func (clock *testClock) Now() time.Time {
	clock.mu.Lock()
	defer clock.mu.Unlock()
	clock.now = clock.now.Add(time.Second)
	return clock.now
}

type testIDs struct {
	mu   sync.Mutex
	next int
}

func (ids *testIDs) NewID() string {
	ids.mu.Lock()
	defer ids.mu.Unlock()
	ids.next++
	return domain.DeterministicOnboardingUUID("claim", ids.next)
}

type testTeacher struct{}

func (testTeacher) Execute(context.Context, string) (domain.PersonalTeacher, error) {
	return domain.PersonalTeacher{ID: testTeacherID, StudentID: testStudentID}, nil
}

type testDialog struct {
	mu               sync.Mutex
	sources          map[string]domain.DialogAssistantUISource
	messages         map[string]domain.DialogMessage
	appendCalls      int
	mutations        int
	materializeCalls int
	appendErrOnce    bool
}

type testInteractions struct {
	items   map[string]domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction
	current string
}

func (store *testInteractions) EnsureActiveInteraction(_ context.Context, candidate domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction) (domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction, bool, error) {
	normalized, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherOnboardingInteraction(candidate)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction{}, false, err
	}
	if store.current != "" {
		current := store.items[store.current]
		if current.ID == normalized.ID {
			return current, false, nil
		}
		if current.State == domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionReserved {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction{}, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
		}
		current.State = domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionSuperseded
		current.SupersededByID = normalized.ID
		current.UpdatedAt = normalized.CreatedAt
		store.items[current.ID] = current
	}
	store.items[normalized.ID] = normalized
	store.current = normalized.ID
	return normalized, true, nil
}

func (store *testInteractions) GetActiveInteraction(_ context.Context, dialogID, promptID, teacherID string) (domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction, bool, error) {
	current := store.items[store.current]
	found := (current.State == domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionActive || current.State == domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionReserved) &&
		current.DialogID == dialogID && current.PromptMessageID == promptID && current.PersonalTeacherID == teacherID
	return current, found, nil
}

func (store *testInteractions) FindRecoverableInteractionForStudent(_ context.Context, studentID string) (domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction, bool, error) {
	var current domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction
	count := 0
	for _, interaction := range store.items {
		if interaction.StudentID == studentID && (interaction.State == domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionActive || interaction.State == domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionReserved || interaction.State == domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionHandoffPending) {
			current = interaction
			count++
		}
	}
	if count > 1 {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction{}, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHistoricalSessionUnavailable
	}
	return current, count == 1, nil
}

func (store *testInteractions) HasInteractionHistory(_ context.Context, studentID string) (bool, error) {
	for _, interaction := range store.items {
		if interaction.StudentID == studentID {
			return true, nil
		}
	}
	return false, nil
}

func (store *testInteractions) CloseActiveInteractionForTerminal(_ context.Context, dialogID, teacherID string, reason domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionClosedReason, now time.Time) (domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction, bool, error) {
	current := store.items[store.current]
	if current.DialogID != dialogID || current.PersonalTeacherID != teacherID ||
		(current.State != domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionActive && current.State != domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionReserved) {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction{}, false, nil
	}
	if current.State == domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionReserved {
		return current, true, nil
	}
	current.State = domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionClosed
	current.ClosedReason = reason
	current.ClosedAt = now
	current.UpdatedAt = now
	store.items[current.ID] = current
	store.current = ""
	return current, true, nil
}

func (dialog *testDialog) EnsureTeacherDialog(context.Context, string, string, domain.LearningContextType, string) (domain.TeacherDialogBinding, error) {
	return domain.TeacherDialogBinding{ID: testDialogID, StudentID: testStudentID, PersonalTeacherID: testTeacherID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral}, nil
}
func (dialog *testDialog) AppendTeacherStructuredProactive(_ context.Context, binding domain.TeacherDialogBinding, key, body string, ui json.RawMessage) (domain.DialogMessage, error) {
	return dialog.append(binding, key, body, ui)
}
func (dialog *testDialog) AppendTeacherProactive(_ context.Context, binding domain.TeacherDialogBinding, key, body string) (domain.DialogMessage, error) {
	return dialog.append(binding, key, body, nil)
}
func (dialog *testDialog) append(binding domain.TeacherDialogBinding, key, body string, ui json.RawMessage) (domain.DialogMessage, error) {
	dialog.mu.Lock()
	defer dialog.mu.Unlock()
	dialog.appendCalls++
	if dialog.appendErrOnce {
		dialog.appendErrOnce = false
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, errors.New("dialog unavailable")
	}
	if item, ok := dialog.messages[key]; ok {
		return item, nil
	}
	dialog.mutations++
	id := domain.DeterministicOnboardingUUID("message", key)
	message := domain.DialogMessage{ID: id, DialogID: binding.ID, AuthorType: domain.DialogMessageAuthorPersonalTeacher, Channel: domain.DialogMessageChannelWeb, PersonalTeacherID: binding.PersonalTeacherID, Body: body, AssistantUI: ui, Status: 1, Version: 1, MessageSequence: int64(dialog.mutations), LastEventSequence: int64(dialog.mutations), CreatedAt: time.Date(2026, 9, 5, 8, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)}
	dialog.messages[key] = message
	if len(ui) > 0 {
		dialog.sources[id] = domain.DialogAssistantUISource{Schema: domain.DialogAssistantUISourceSchema, DialogID: binding.ID, StudentID: binding.StudentID, PersonalTeacherID: binding.PersonalTeacherID, ContextType: "general_teacher", MessageID: id, MessageSequence: message.MessageSequence, MessageVersion: 1, AssistantUI: ui}
	}
	return message, nil
}
func (dialog *testDialog) GetAssistantUISource(_ context.Context, _ domain.TeacherDialogBinding, messageID string) (domain.DialogAssistantUISource, error) {
	dialog.mu.Lock()
	defer dialog.mu.Unlock()
	source, ok := dialog.sources[messageID]
	if !ok {
		return source, domain.ErrDialogRequestNotFound
	}
	return source, nil
}

type testTerminalSessions struct {
	record       domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession
	failMarkOnce bool
}

func (store *testTerminalSessions) EnsurePending(_ context.Context, candidate domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession) (domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession, bool, error) {
	if store.record.ID != "" {
		return store.record, false, nil
	}
	store.record = candidate
	return candidate, true, nil
}

func (store *testTerminalSessions) FindOnlyRecoverableForStudent(_ context.Context, studentID string) (domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession, bool, error) {
	return store.record, store.record.ID != "" && store.record.StudentID == studentID, nil
}

func (store *testTerminalSessions) MarkDelivered(_ context.Context, id, messageID string, now time.Time) (domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession, error) {
	if store.failMarkOnce {
		store.failMarkOnce = false
		return store.record, errors.New("postgres unavailable")
	}
	if store.record.ID != id {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	store.record.Status = domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalDelivered
	store.record.DialogMessageID = messageID
	store.record.DeliveredAt = now
	store.record.UpdatedAt = now
	return store.record, nil
}

func (stub *testPathOutcomeProjection) FindDeliveredForSession(_ context.Context, studentID, personalTeacherID, dialogID string, stateRef domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef) (domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarker, bool, error) {
	stub.calls++
	stub.studentID, stub.personalTeacherID, stub.dialogID, stub.stateRef = studentID, personalTeacherID, dialogID, stateRef
	return stub.marker, stub.found, stub.err
}

func (stub *testHandoffs) Enqueue(_ context.Context, input repository.TeacherOnboardingHandoffEnqueue, _ time.Time) (domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent, bool, error) {
	stub.calls++
	if stub.err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, stub.err
	}
	if stub.intent.ID != "" {
		return stub.intent, false, nil
	}
	if input.Intent.SourceInteractionID == "" && stub.interactions != nil && stub.interactions.current != "" {
		interaction := stub.interactions.items[stub.interactions.current]
		if interaction.State == domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionReserved {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingBusy
		}
		interaction.State = domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionClosed
		interaction.ClosedReason = domain.TeacherOnboardingClosedPlanningReady
		interaction.ClosedAt = input.Intent.CreatedAt
		interaction.UpdatedAt = input.Intent.CreatedAt
		stub.interactions.items[interaction.ID] = interaction
		stub.interactions.current = ""
	}
	stub.intent = input.Intent
	return stub.intent, true, nil
}
func (stub *testHandoffs) GetByStudentState(_ context.Context, _ string, _ domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef, _ domain.TeacherLearningReadinessGoal) (domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent, bool, error) {
	stub.reads++
	return stub.intent, stub.intent.ID != "", stub.err
}
func (stub *testHandoffs) FindOnlyRecoverableHandoffForStudent(_ context.Context, studentID string) (domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent, bool, error) {
	stub.reads++
	validOrigin := (stub.intent.SourceInteractionID == "" && stub.intent.SourceTeacherJobID == "") || (stub.intent.SourceInteractionID != "" && stub.intent.SourceTeacherJobID != "")
	return stub.intent, stub.intent.ID != "" && stub.intent.StudentID == studentID && stub.intent.Status != domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffBlocked && validOrigin, stub.err
}
func (stub *testHandoffs) GetBySourceSession(_ context.Context, studentID, interactionID, teacherJobID string) (domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent, bool, error) {
	stub.reads++
	found := stub.intent.ID != "" && stub.intent.StudentID == studentID && stub.intent.SourceInteractionID == interactionID && stub.intent.SourceTeacherJobID == teacherJobID
	return stub.intent, found, stub.err
}
func (stub *testHandoffs) HasHandoffHistory(_ context.Context, studentID string) (bool, error) {
	stub.reads++
	return stub.intent.ID != "" && stub.intent.StudentID == studentID, stub.err
}

func (student *testStudent) GetTeacherOnboardingState(context.Context, string) (domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingState, error) {
	return student.state, nil
}
func (student *testStudent) ReplaceTeacherOnboardingDraft(_ context.Context, _ string, key string, expected int64, answers domain.StudentOnboardingAnswers) (domain.StudentOnboardingDraft, error) {
	student.replaceCalls++
	if value, ok := student.commands[key]; ok {
		return value, nil
	}
	if student.state.Draft.Version != expected {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingDraft{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	student.mutations++
	student.state.Draft.StudentOnboardingAnswers = answers
	student.state.Draft.Version++
	student.commands[key] = student.state.Draft
	return student.state.Draft, nil
}
func (student *testStudent) FinalizeTeacherOnboardingDraft(_ context.Context, _ string, key string, expectedDraft, expectedProfile int64) (domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResponse, error) {
	if value, ok := student.commands[key]; ok {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResponse{Schema: domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResult, Draft: value, Profile: domain.StudentOnboardingProfile{StudentID: testStudentID, ProfileVersion: "student-onboarding-v1", Version: *value.CompletedProfileVersion}}, nil
	}
	if student.state.Draft.Version != expectedDraft || student.state.ProfileVersion != expectedProfile {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResponse{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	student.mutations++
	profileVersion := expectedProfile + 1
	student.state.Draft.Status = domain.StudentOnboardingDraftCompleted
	student.state.Draft.Version++
	student.state.Draft.StudentOnboardingAnswers = domain.StudentOnboardingAnswers{}
	student.state.Draft.CompletedProfileVersion = &profileVersion
	student.state.ProfileVersion = profileVersion
	student.commands[key] = student.state.Draft
	return domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResponse{Schema: domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResult, Draft: student.state.Draft, Profile: domain.StudentOnboardingProfile{StudentID: testStudentID, ProfileVersion: "student-onboarding-v1", Version: profileVersion}}, nil
}

type testReceiptStore struct {
	mu               sync.Mutex
	items            map[string]domain.OnboardingActionReceipt
	active           map[string]string
	failMarkOnce     bool
	failCompleteOnce bool
	completeStarted  chan<- struct{}
	completeRelease  <-chan struct{}
}

func (store *testReceiptStore) Get(_ context.Context, key string) (domain.OnboardingActionReceipt, bool, error) {
	store.mu.Lock()
	defer store.mu.Unlock()
	item, ok := store.items[key]
	return item, ok, nil
}

func (store *testReceiptStore) Claim(_ context.Context, candidate domain.OnboardingActionReceipt) (domain.OnboardingActionReceipt, bool, error) {
	store.mu.Lock()
	defer store.mu.Unlock()
	if existing, ok := store.items[candidate.IdempotencyKey]; ok {
		if !domain.ReceiptMatches(existing, candidate) && !domain.ReceiptReplayMatches(existing, candidate) {
			return existing, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
		}
		if existing.Status == domain.OnboardingReceiptCompleted || existing.Status == domain.OnboardingReceiptMaterialized || existing.Status == domain.OnboardingReceiptRejected {
			return existing, false, nil
		}
		if existing.ClaimToken != "" {
			return existing, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingBusy
		}
		existing.ClaimToken = candidate.ClaimToken
		existing.LockedUntil = candidate.LockedUntil
		store.items[candidate.IdempotencyKey] = existing
		return existing, false, nil
	}
	for _, existing := range store.items {
		if existing.IdempotencyKey != candidate.IdempotencyKey && existing.ExecutionMode == domain.OnboardingActionExecutionCanonical &&
			(existing.Status == domain.OnboardingReceiptClaimed || existing.Status == domain.OnboardingReceiptApplied || existing.Status == domain.OnboardingReceiptMaterialized) &&
			existing.DialogID == candidate.DialogID && existing.SourceMessageID == candidate.SourceMessageID && existing.SourceMessageVersion == candidate.SourceMessageVersion {
			return candidate, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
		}
	}
	scope := candidate.StudentID + candidate.DialogID
	if _, ok := store.active[scope]; ok {
		return candidate, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingBusy
	}
	store.items[candidate.IdempotencyKey] = candidate
	store.active[scope] = candidate.IdempotencyKey
	return candidate, true, nil
}
func (store *testReceiptStore) Resolve(_ context.Context, key, claim string, draft, profile int64, _ time.Time) (domain.OnboardingActionReceipt, error) {
	store.mu.Lock()
	defer store.mu.Unlock()
	item := store.items[key]
	if item.ClaimToken != claim {
		return item, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	item.ExpectedDraftVersion = &draft
	item.ExpectedProfileVersion = &profile
	store.items[key] = item
	return item, nil
}
func (store *testReceiptStore) MarkApplied(_ context.Context, key, claim string, draft, profile int64, status domain.StudentOnboardingDraftStatus, _ time.Time) (domain.OnboardingActionReceipt, error) {
	store.mu.Lock()
	defer store.mu.Unlock()
	item := store.items[key]
	if store.failMarkOnce {
		store.failMarkOnce = false
		return item, errors.New("postgres unavailable")
	}
	if item.ClaimToken != claim {
		return item, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	item.Status = domain.OnboardingReceiptApplied
	item.ResultDraftVersion = &draft
	item.ResultProfileVersion = &profile
	item.ResultStatus = status
	store.items[key] = item
	return item, nil
}
func (store *testReceiptStore) Complete(_ context.Context, key, claim, message string, now time.Time) (domain.OnboardingActionReceipt, error) {
	store.mu.Lock()
	if store.completeStarted != nil {
		select {
		case store.completeStarted <- struct{}{}:
		default:
		}
		release := store.completeRelease
		store.mu.Unlock()
		if release != nil {
			<-release
		}
		store.mu.Lock()
	}
	defer store.mu.Unlock()
	item := store.items[key]
	if store.failCompleteOnce {
		store.failCompleteOnce = false
		return item, errors.New("postgres unavailable")
	}
	if item.ClaimToken != claim {
		return item, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	item.Status = domain.OnboardingReceiptCompleted
	item.NextMessageID = message
	item.CompletedAt = &now
	item.ClaimToken = ""
	item.LockedUntil = nil
	store.items[key] = item
	delete(store.active, item.StudentID+item.DialogID)
	return item, nil
}
func (store *testReceiptStore) CompleteCanonical(_ context.Context, key, claim, message string, now time.Time) (domain.OnboardingActionReceipt, error) {
	store.mu.Lock()
	if store.completeStarted != nil {
		select {
		case store.completeStarted <- struct{}{}:
		default:
		}
		release := store.completeRelease
		store.mu.Unlock()
		if release != nil {
			<-release
		}
		store.mu.Lock()
	}
	defer store.mu.Unlock()
	item := store.items[key]
	if store.failCompleteOnce {
		store.failCompleteOnce = false
		return item, errors.New("postgres unavailable")
	}
	if item.ClaimToken != claim || item.ExecutionMode != domain.OnboardingActionExecutionCanonical {
		return item, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	item.Status = domain.OnboardingReceiptMaterialized
	item.CanonicalStudentMessageID = message
	item.CompletedAt = &now
	item.ClaimToken = ""
	item.LockedUntil = nil
	store.items[key] = item
	delete(store.active, item.StudentID+item.DialogID)
	return item, nil
}
func (store *testReceiptStore) Reject(_ context.Context, key, claim string, _ time.Time) error {
	store.mu.Lock()
	defer store.mu.Unlock()
	item := store.items[key]
	if item.ClaimToken != claim {
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	item.Status = domain.OnboardingReceiptRejected
	item.ClaimToken = ""
	item.LockedUntil = nil
	store.items[key] = item
	delete(store.active, item.StudentID+item.DialogID)
	return nil
}
func (store *testReceiptStore) Release(_ context.Context, key, claim string, _ time.Time) error {
	store.mu.Lock()
	defer store.mu.Unlock()
	item := store.items[key]
	if item.ClaimToken == claim {
		item.ClaimToken = ""
		item.LockedUntil = nil
		store.items[key] = item
	}
	return nil
}

func TestS11NewEnsureAndActionUseCanonicalCoordinatorAdmissionOnly(t *testing.T) {
	service, student, dialog, receipts := newTestService()
	session, err := service.Ensure(context.Background(), testStudentID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	messageID, messageVersion := sessionPrompt(t, session)

	request := actionRequest(messageID, messageVersion, "onboarding.goal.d0.v2", "goal.learn_programming", "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555")
	first, err := service.ApplyAction(context.Background(), testStudentID, request)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotNil(t, first.V2)
	require.Equal(t, domain.OnboardingActionExecutionCanonical, domain.OnboardingActionExecutionMode(first.V2.Mode))
	require.True(t, first.V2.Materialized)
	require.False(t, first.V2.Replayed)
	require.Zero(t, student.replaceCalls)
	require.Zero(t, student.mutations)
	require.Equal(t, 1, dialog.materializeCalls)
	require.Equal(t, domain.OnboardingActionExecutionCanonical, receipts.items[request.IdempotencyKey].ExecutionMode)

	replayed, err := service.ApplyAction(context.Background(), testStudentID, request)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotNil(t, replayed.V2)
	require.True(t, replayed.V2.Replayed)
	require.Equal(t, first.V2.CanonicalStudentMessageID, replayed.V2.CanonicalStudentMessageID)
	require.Equal(t, 1, dialog.materializeCalls)
}

func TestS11FlagsOffFailClosedBeforeStudentOrDialogSideEffects(t *testing.T) {
	service, student, dialog, receipts := newTestService()
	service.CanonicalActionsEnabled = false
	service.UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled = false

	_, err := service.Ensure(context.Background(), testStudentID)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable)
	require.Zero(t, student.replaceCalls)
	require.Zero(t, student.mutations)
	require.Zero(t, dialog.appendCalls)
	require.Zero(t, dialog.materializeCalls)

	request := actionRequest(testDialogID, 1, "onboarding.direction.d0.v1", "direction.backend", "56565656-5656-4656-8656-565656565656")
	_, err = service.ApplyAction(context.Background(), testStudentID, request)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable)
	require.Empty(t, receipts.items)
	require.Zero(t, student.replaceCalls)
	require.Zero(t, student.mutations)
	require.Zero(t, dialog.appendCalls)
	require.Zero(t, dialog.materializeCalls)
}

func TestS11FlagsOffReadExistingV1SessionWithoutMutation(t *testing.T) {
	service, student, dialog, _ := newTestService()
	interaction := installCollectingInteraction(t, service, 1)
	service.CanonicalActionsEnabled = false
	service.UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled = false
	service.ProductAwareEnabled = false
	service.PlannerHandoffEnabled = false
	service.Teachers = nil
	service.Dialogs = nil
	service.Students = nil
	service.StructuredMessages = nil
	service.CanonicalMessages = nil

	got, err := service.Ensure(context.Background(), testStudentID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionSchema, got.Schema)
	require.Equal(t, interaction.PromptMessageID, *got.MessageID)
	require.Equal(t, int(interaction.PromptMessageVersion), *got.MessageVersion)
	require.Zero(t, dialog.appendCalls)
	require.Zero(t, student.mutations)
}

func TestS11FlagsOffReadExistingV2AndV3CollectingSessions(t *testing.T) {
	for _, version := range []int{2, 3} {
		t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("v%d", version), func(t *testing.T) {
			service, student, dialog, _ := newTestService()
			interaction := installCollectingInteraction(t, service, version)
			service.CanonicalActionsEnabled = false
			service.UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled = false
			service.ProductAwareEnabled = false
			service.PlannerHandoffEnabled = false
			service.Teachers = nil
			service.Dialogs = nil
			service.Students = nil
			service.StructuredMessages = nil
			service.CanonicalMessages = nil
			service.Readiness = nil

			got, err := service.Ensure(context.Background(), testStudentID)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			if version == 2 {
				require.NotNil(t, got.V2)
				require.Equal(t, interaction.PromptMessageID, got.V2.CurrentPrompt.MessageID)
			} else {
				require.NotNil(t, got.V3)
				require.Equal(t, interaction.PromptMessageID, got.V3.CurrentPrompt.MessageID)
			}
			require.Zero(t, dialog.appendCalls)
			require.Zero(t, student.mutations)
		})
	}
}

func TestS11TerminalLegacyReceiptReplaysExactlyWithFlagsOff(t *testing.T) {
	service, student, dialog, receipts := newTestService()
	service.CanonicalActionsEnabled = false
	service.UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled = false
	request := actionRequest("57575757-5757-4757-8757-575757575757", 3, "onboarding.direction.d0.v1", "direction.backend", "58585858-5858-4858-8858-585858585858")
	now := service.Clock.Now().UTC()
	receipt, err := domain.NewOnboardingActionReceipt(request, testStudentID, testTeacherID, service.IDs.NewID(), now, now.Add(time.Minute))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	expectedDraft, expectedProfile := int64(0), int64(0)
	resultDraft, resultProfile := int64(1), int64(0)
	completedAt := now.Add(time.Second)
	receipt.Status = domain.OnboardingReceiptCompleted
	receipt.ExpectedDraftVersion, receipt.ExpectedProfileVersion = &expectedDraft, &expectedProfile
	receipt.ResultDraftVersion, receipt.ResultProfileVersion = &resultDraft, &resultProfile
	receipt.ResultStatus = domain.StudentOnboardingDraftDraft
	receipt.NextMessageID = "59595959-5959-4959-8959-595959595959"
	receipt.ClaimToken, receipt.LockedUntil = "", nil
	receipt.UpdatedAt, receipt.CompletedAt = completedAt, &completedAt
	receipts.items[request.IdempotencyKey] = receipt

	result, err := service.ApplyAction(context.Background(), testStudentID, request)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Nil(t, result.V2)
	require.True(t, result.Applied)
	require.True(t, result.Replayed)
	require.Equal(t, resultDraft, result.DraftVersion)
	require.Equal(t, receipt.NextMessageID, *result.NextMessageID)
	changed := request
	changed.ActionID = "direction.frontend"
	_, err = service.ApplyAction(context.Background(), testStudentID, changed)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict)
	_, err = service.ApplyAction(context.Background(), "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999", request)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict)
	require.Zero(t, student.replaceCalls)
	require.Zero(t, student.mutations)
	require.Zero(t, dialog.appendCalls)
	require.Zero(t, dialog.materializeCalls)
}

	service, student, dialog, receipts := newTestService()
	request := actionRequest("60606060-6060-4060-8060-606060606060", 1, "onboarding.direction.d0.v1", "direction.backend", "61616161-6161-4161-8161-616161616161")

func TestS11EnsureReusesPersistedV3PromptWithoutDuplicateDialogMutation(t *testing.T) {
	service, _, dialog, _ := newTestService()
	first, err := service.Ensure(context.Background(), testStudentID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	firstMessageID, firstMessageVersion := sessionPrompt(t, first)

	second, err := service.Ensure(context.Background(), testStudentID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	secondMessageID, secondMessageVersion := sessionPrompt(t, second)
	require.Equal(t, firstMessageID, secondMessageID)
	require.Equal(t, firstMessageVersion, secondMessageVersion)
	require.Equal(t, 1, dialog.mutations)
}

func TestS11ConcurrentEnsureAndCanonicalActionKeepPersistedPromptIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	service, _, dialog, receipts := newTestService()
	session, err := service.Ensure(context.Background(), testStudentID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	messageID, messageVersion := sessionPrompt(t, session)
	started, release := make(chan struct{}, 1), make(chan struct{})
	receipts.completeStarted, receipts.completeRelease = started, release
	type actionOutcome struct {
		result domain.AssistantUIActionResult
		err    error
	}
	outcome := make(chan actionOutcome, 1)
	go func() {
		result, actionErr := service.ApplyAction(context.Background(), testStudentID,
			actionRequest(messageID, messageVersion, "onboarding.goal.d0.v2", "goal.learn_programming", "93939393-9393-4939-8939-939393939393"))
		outcome <- actionOutcome{result: result, err: actionErr}
	}()
	select {
	case <-started:
	case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("canonical action did not reach durable receipt completion")
	}
	refreshed, err := service.Ensure(context.Background(), testStudentID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	refreshedMessageID, refreshedMessageVersion := sessionPrompt(t, refreshed)
	require.Equal(t, messageID, refreshedMessageID)
	require.Equal(t, messageVersion, refreshedMessageVersion)
	close(release)
	completed := <-outcome
	require.NoError(t, completed.err)
	require.NotNil(t, completed.result.V2)
	require.Equal(t, 1, dialog.mutations, "Ensure never invents the coordinator's next prompt")
	require.Equal(t, 1, dialog.materializeCalls)
}

	candidate, err := domain.NewOnboardingActionReceiptForMode(request, testStudentID, testTeacherID, service.IDs.NewID(), now, now.Add(time.Minute), domain.OnboardingActionExecutionCanonical)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	claimed, _, err := receipts.Claim(context.Background(), candidate)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	claimed.ClaimToken = ""
	claimed.LockedUntil = nil
	receipts.items[request.IdempotencyKey] = claimed

	service.CanonicalActionsEnabled = false
	service.UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled = false
	service.ProductAwareEnabled = false
	service.PlannerHandoffEnabled = false
	result, err := service.ApplyAction(context.Background(), testStudentID, request)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotNil(t, result.V2)
	require.True(t, result.V2.Materialized)
	require.Zero(t, student.mutations)
	require.Equal(t, 1, dialog.materializeCalls)
}

func TestS11CanonicalActionRecoversCrashAfterDialogMaterialization(t *testing.T) {
	service, student, dialog, receipts := newTestService()
	session, err := service.Ensure(context.Background(), testStudentID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	messageID, messageVersion := sessionPrompt(t, session)
	request := actionRequest(messageID, messageVersion, "onboarding.goal.d0.v2", "goal.learn_programming", "94949494-9494-4949-8949-949494949494")
	receipts.failCompleteOnce = true

	_, err = service.ApplyAction(context.Background(), testStudentID, request)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable)
	recovered, err := service.ApplyAction(context.Background(), testStudentID, request)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotNil(t, recovered.V2)
	require.True(t, recovered.V2.Materialized)
	replayed, err := service.ApplyAction(context.Background(), testStudentID, request)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, replayed.V2.Replayed)
	require.Equal(t, recovered.V2.CanonicalStudentMessageID, replayed.V2.CanonicalStudentMessageID)
	require.Equal(t, 2, dialog.materializeCalls, "the retry uses the same deterministic Dialog command")
	require.Zero(t, student.mutations)
}

			registry.current = ""

			service.UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled = false
			service.ProductAwareEnabled = false
			service.PlannerHandoffEnabled = false

			_, err := service.Ensure(context.Background(), testStudentID)

			require.Zero(t, student.mutations)
			require.Zero(t, dialog.appendCalls)
		})
	}
}

		Schema: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessSchema, Result: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessReady,

		Goal: &domain.TeacherLearningReadinessGoal{Code: domain.TeacherFoundationGoalCode, Version: domain.TeacherFoundationGoalVersion, GraphVersion: domain.TeacherFoundationGraphVersion},
	}

		domain.PersonalTeacher{ID: testTeacherID, StudentID: testStudentID},
		domain.TeacherDialogBinding{ID: testDialogID, StudentID: testStudentID, PersonalTeacherID: testTeacherID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral},

	)

func TestS11NoEvidenceRequiresEveryAdmissionFlagBeforeDownstreamEffects(t *testing.T) {
	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		name    string
		disable func(*Service)
	}{
		{name: "canonical", disable: func(service *Service) { service.CanonicalActionsEnabled = false }},
		{name: "unified", disable: func(service *Service) { service.UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled = false }},
		{name: "product", disable: func(service *Service) { service.ProductAwareEnabled = false }},
		{name: "handoff", disable: func(service *Service) { service.PlannerHandoffEnabled = false }},
	} {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			service, student, dialog, _ := newTestService()
			readiness := &testReadiness{}
			handoffs := &testHandoffs{}
			service.Readiness, service.Handoffs = readiness, handoffs
			testCase.disable(service)
			_, err := service.Ensure(context.Background(), testStudentID)
			require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable)
			require.Zero(t, readiness.calls)
			require.Zero(t, handoffs.calls)
			require.Zero(t, student.mutations)
			require.Zero(t, dialog.appendCalls)
			require.Zero(t, dialog.materializeCalls)
		})
	}
}

func TestDurableHandoffEnsureReturnsV3PendingThenAcceptedWithoutS7TerminalMessage(t *testing.T) {
	service, student, dialog, _ := newTestService()
	goal, experience, direction, language := "learn_programming", "beginner", "undecided", "ru"
	student.state.Draft.Version = 4
	student.state.Draft.GoalCode, student.state.Draft.SelfAssessedExperience, student.state.Draft.DirectionCode, student.state.Draft.PreferredLanguage = &goal, &experience, &direction, &language
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 11, 8, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	student.state.Draft.CreatedAt, student.state.Draft.UpdatedAt = &now, &now
	readiness := &testReadiness{result: domain.TeacherLearningReadiness{
		Schema: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessSchema, Result: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessReady,
		ReasonCodes: []string{domain.TeacherReadinessReasonFoundationGraphResolved}, ResolverVersion: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessResolver,
		StateRef: domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: domain.TeacherReadinessStateDraft, Version: 4}, ReadinessScope: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessScope,
		ContentStatus: domain.TeacherLearningContentNotCreated, Goal: &domain.TeacherLearningReadinessGoal{Code: domain.TeacherFoundationGoalCode, Version: domain.TeacherFoundationGoalVersion, GraphVersion: domain.TeacherFoundationGraphVersion},
	}}
	handoffs := &testHandoffs{}
	service.Readiness, service.Handoffs = readiness, handoffs
	service.ProductAwareEnabled, service.PlannerHandoffEnabled, service.UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled = true, true, true
	pending, err := service.Ensure(context.Background(), testStudentID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Nil(t, pending.V2)
	require.NotNil(t, pending.V3)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionHandoffPending, pending.V3.Status)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherLearningContentNotCreated, pending.V3.Terminal.ContentStatus)
	require.Zero(t, dialog.mutations, "READY no longer emits the S7 planning-ready terminal")

	handoffs.intent.Status = domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffAcceptedStatus
	handoffs.intent.SourceTeacherJobID = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
	handoffs.intent.SourceInteractionID = "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888"
	handoffs.intent.PlannerHandoffID = "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666"
	handoffs.intent.AcceptedAt = now.Add(time.Minute)
	handoffs.intent.ReadinessObservedAt = now
	accepted, err := service.Ensure(context.Background(), testStudentID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionHandoffAccepted, accepted.V3.Status)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherOnboardingExecutionNotStarted, accepted.V3.Terminal.ExecutionStatus)
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(accepted)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotContains(t, string(encoded), handoffs.intent.PlannerHandoffID)
	require.NotContains(t, string(encoded), handoffs.intent.ID)
	require.Equal(t, 1, handoffs.calls, "source-bound refresh reads the existing ledger instead of originless re-enqueue")
	require.GreaterOrEqual(t, handoffs.reads, 2)

}

func TestAttachDeliveredPathOutcomeExposesOnlyExactDialogDeliveryMarker(t *testing.T) {
	stateRef := domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: domain.TeacherReadinessStateDraft, Version: 4}
	session, err := domain.DurableHandoffTeacherOnboardingSession(domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionV3{
		Schema: domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionV3Schema, DialogID: testDialogID,
		Status: domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionHandoffAccepted, Phase: domain.TeacherOnboardingPhaseReadyToStart, StateRef: stateRef,
		Terminal: &domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalV3{Kind: domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionHandoffAccepted, DisplayName: domain.TeacherGoBackendGoalDisplayName, ExecutionStatus: domain.TeacherOnboardingExecutionNotStarted, ContentStatus: domain.TeacherLearningContentNotCreated},
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	marker := domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarker{
		Kind: domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarkerKind, Status: domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarkerReady,
		DialogMessageID: "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999",
	}
	projection := &testPathOutcomeProjection{marker: marker, found: true}
	service := Service{PathOutcomeEnabled: true, PathOutcomes: projection}

	result, err := service.attachDeliveredPathOutcome(context.Background(), domain.PersonalTeacher{ID: testTeacherID, StudentID: testStudentID}, session)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, marker, *result.V3.PathOutcome)
	require.Equal(t, testStudentID, projection.studentID)
	require.Equal(t, testTeacherID, projection.personalTeacherID)
	require.Equal(t, testDialogID, projection.dialogID)
	require.Equal(t, stateRef, projection.stateRef)

	encoded, err := json.Marshal(result)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.JSONEq(t, `{
		"schema":"teacher-onboarding-session.v3",
		"dialog_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		"status":"PLANNER_HANDOFF_ACCEPTED",
		"phase":"READY_TO_START",
		"state_ref":{"kind":"accepted_draft","version":4},
		"terminal":{"kind":"PLANNER_HANDOFF_ACCEPTED","display_name":"Go backend","execution_status":"NOT_STARTED","content_status":"NOT_CREATED"},
		"path_outcome":{"kind":"ONBOARDING_PATH_OUTCOME","status":"PATH_READY","dialog_message_id":"99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999"}
	}`, string(encoded))
}

func TestS11V3EnsureSupersedesPromptAndTerminalHandoffClosesCurrentPrompt(t *testing.T) {
	service, student, _, _ := newTestService()
	service.UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled = true
	initial, err := service.Ensure(context.Background(), testStudentID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	initialMessageID, _ := sessionPrompt(t, initial)
	registry := service.Interactions.(*testInteractions)
	legacyInteraction := registry.items[registry.current]

	readiness := &testReadiness{result: domain.TeacherLearningReadiness{
		Schema: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessSchema, Result: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessNeedsClarification,
		ReasonCodes: []string{domain.TeacherReadinessReasonLearningIntentMissing}, ResolverVersion: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessResolver,
		StateRef: domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: domain.TeacherReadinessStateNone, Version: 0}, ReadinessScope: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessScope,
		ContentStatus: domain.TeacherLearningContentNotCreated,
	}}
	service.Readiness, service.ProductAwareEnabled = readiness, true
	v3, err := service.Ensure(context.Background(), testStudentID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionV3Collecting, v3.V3.Status)
	require.Equal(t, initialMessageID, v3.V3.CurrentPrompt.MessageID)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionActive, registry.items[legacyInteraction.ID].State)

	goal, experience, direction, language := "learn_programming", "beginner", "undecided", "ru"
	student.state.Draft.Version = 4
	student.state.Draft.GoalCode, student.state.Draft.SelfAssessedExperience, student.state.Draft.DirectionCode, student.state.Draft.PreferredLanguage = &goal, &experience, &direction, &language
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 5, 8, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	student.state.Draft.CreatedAt, student.state.Draft.UpdatedAt = &now, &now
	readiness.result = domain.TeacherLearningReadiness{Schema: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessSchema, Result: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessReady,
		ReasonCodes: []string{domain.TeacherReadinessReasonFoundationGraphResolved}, ResolverVersion: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessResolver,
		StateRef: domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: domain.TeacherReadinessStateDraft, Version: 4}, ReadinessScope: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessScope,
		ContentStatus: domain.TeacherLearningContentNotCreated, Goal: &domain.TeacherLearningReadinessGoal{Code: domain.TeacherFoundationGoalCode, Version: domain.TeacherFoundationGoalVersion, GraphVersion: domain.TeacherFoundationGraphVersion}}
	_, err = service.Ensure(context.Background(), testStudentID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	for _, interaction := range registry.items {
		require.NotEqual(t, domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionActive, interaction.State)
		require.NotEqual(t, domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionReserved, interaction.State)
	}
}

func TestActionAfterV3TerminalRejectsBeforeDialogOrStudentAndMaterializedReplaySurvives(t *testing.T) {
	service, student, dialog, receipts := newTestService()
	service.UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled = true
	service.CanonicalActionsEnabled = true
	session, err := service.Ensure(context.Background(), testStudentID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	service.CanonicalMessages = dialog
	messageID, messageVersion := sessionPrompt(t, session)

	request := actionRequest(messageID, messageVersion, "onboarding.goal.d0.v2", "goal.learn_programming", "93939393-9393-4939-8939-939393939393")
	materialized, err := service.ApplyAction(context.Background(), testStudentID, request)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotNil(t, materialized.V2)
	registry := service.Interactions.(*testInteractions)
	current := registry.items[registry.current]
	current.State = domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionClosed
	current.ClosedReason = domain.TeacherOnboardingClosedPlanningReady
	current.ClosedAt = service.Clock.Now()
	current.UpdatedAt = current.ClosedAt
	registry.items[current.ID] = current
	registry.current = ""

	replayed, err := service.ApplyAction(context.Background(), testStudentID, request)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, replayed.V2.Replayed)
	require.Equal(t, materialized.V2.CanonicalStudentMessageID, replayed.V2.CanonicalStudentMessageID)
	require.Equal(t, 1, dialog.materializeCalls)

	stale := request
	stale.IdempotencyKey = "94949494-9494-4949-8949-949494949494"
	stale.ActionID = "goal.unsupported"
	beforeStudent := student.replaceCalls
	_, err = service.ApplyAction(context.Background(), testStudentID, stale)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable)
	require.Equal(t, 1, dialog.materializeCalls)
	require.Equal(t, beforeStudent, student.replaceCalls)
	_, staleReceiptExists := receipts.items[stale.IdempotencyKey]
	require.False(t, staleReceiptExists, "prompt-level receipt fence rejects before a second claim is stored")
}

func TestS11TerminalEnsureDoesNotStealReservedV3Prompt(t *testing.T) {
	service, student, dialog, _ := newTestService()
	service.UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled = true
	initial, err := service.Ensure(context.Background(), testStudentID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	initialMessageID, _ := sessionPrompt(t, initial)
	registry := service.Interactions.(*testInteractions)
	interaction := registry.items[registry.current]
	interaction.State = domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionReserved
	interaction.ReservedTeacherJobID = "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa"
	interaction.ReservationMode = domain.TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorText
	registry.items[interaction.ID] = interaction

	goal, experience, direction, language := "learn_programming", "beginner", "undecided", "ru"
	student.state.Draft.Version = 4
	student.state.Draft.GoalCode, student.state.Draft.SelfAssessedExperience, student.state.Draft.DirectionCode, student.state.Draft.PreferredLanguage = &goal, &experience, &direction, &language
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 5, 8, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	student.state.Draft.CreatedAt, student.state.Draft.UpdatedAt = &now, &now
	service.Readiness = &testReadiness{result: domain.TeacherLearningReadiness{Schema: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessSchema, Result: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessReady,
		ReasonCodes: []string{domain.TeacherReadinessReasonFoundationGraphResolved}, ResolverVersion: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessResolver,
		StateRef: domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: domain.TeacherReadinessStateDraft, Version: 4}, ReadinessScope: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessScope,
		ContentStatus: domain.TeacherLearningContentNotCreated, Goal: &domain.TeacherLearningReadinessGoal{Code: domain.TeacherFoundationGoalCode, Version: domain.TeacherFoundationGoalVersion, GraphVersion: domain.TeacherFoundationGraphVersion}}}
	service.ProductAwareEnabled = true
	session, err := service.Ensure(context.Background(), testStudentID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionV3Collecting, session.V3.Status)
	require.Equal(t, initialMessageID, session.V3.CurrentPrompt.MessageID)
	require.Equal(t, 1, dialog.mutations, "terminal copy is not appended while a real turn owns the prompt")
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionReserved, registry.items[interaction.ID].State)
}

func TestS11ActivePathTerminalRecoversPendingAndAppendCrashExactlyOnceWithFlagsOff(t *testing.T) {
	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		name           string
		failAppendOnce bool
		failAckOnce    bool
	}{{name: "crash after pending", failAppendOnce: true}, {name: "crash after append", failAckOnce: true}} {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			service, student, dialog, _ := newTestService()
			goal, experience, direction, language := "learn_programming", "beginner", "undecided", "en"
			student.state.Draft.Version = 4
			student.state.Draft.GoalCode, student.state.Draft.SelfAssessedExperience = &goal, &experience
			student.state.Draft.DirectionCode, student.state.Draft.PreferredLanguage = &direction, &language
			now := time.Date(2026, 9, 12, 8, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
			student.state.Draft.CreatedAt, student.state.Draft.UpdatedAt = &now, &now
			service.Readiness = &testReadiness{result: domain.TeacherLearningReadiness{
				Schema: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessSchema, Result: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessNotReady,
				ReasonCodes: []string{domain.TeacherReadinessReasonActivePathExists}, ResolverVersion: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessResolver,
				StateRef:       domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: domain.TeacherReadinessStateDraft, Version: 4},
				ReadinessScope: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessScope, ContentStatus: domain.TeacherLearningContentNotCreated,
				ActivePath: &domain.TeacherLearningReadinessActivePath{LearningPathID: "12121212-1212-4212-8212-121212121212", Version: 3, CourseID: "13131313-1313-4313-8313-131313131313", GoalCode: "learn_programming", Status: "ACTIVE"},
			}}
			terminalStore := service.TerminalSessions.(*testTerminalSessions)
			terminalStore.failMarkOnce = testCase.failAckOnce
			dialog.appendErrOnce = testCase.failAppendOnce

			_, err := service.Ensure(context.Background(), testStudentID)
			require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable)
			require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalMessagePending, terminalStore.record.Status)
			service.CanonicalActionsEnabled = false
			service.UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled = false
			service.ProductAwareEnabled = false
			service.PlannerHandoffEnabled = false

			session, err := service.Ensure(context.Background(), testStudentID)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionV3ActivePathExists, session.V3.Status)
			require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalDelivered, terminalStore.record.Status)
			require.Equal(t, 1, dialog.mutations, "the stable terminal message command prevents duplicate Dialog messages")
			beforeCalls := dialog.appendCalls
			service.Students = nil
			service.PlainMessages = nil
			replayed, err := service.Ensure(context.Background(), testStudentID)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Equal(t, session, replayed)
			require.Equal(t, beforeCalls, dialog.appendCalls, "delivered terminal evidence needs no downstream call")
		})
	}
}

func newTestService() (*Service, *testStudent, *testDialog, *testReceiptStore) {
	clock := &testClock{now: time.Date(2026, 9, 5, 8, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)}
	student := &testStudent{state: domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingState{Schema: domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingStateSchema, Draft: domain.StudentOnboardingDraft{Schema: domain.StudentOnboardingDraftSchema, StudentID: testStudentID, Status: domain.StudentOnboardingDraftDraft}, ProfileVersion: 0}, commands: map[string]domain.StudentOnboardingDraft{}}
	dialog := &testDialog{sources: map[string]domain.DialogAssistantUISource{}, messages: map[string]domain.DialogMessage{}}
	store := &testReceiptStore{items: map[string]domain.OnboardingActionReceipt{}, active: map[string]string{}}
	ids := &testIDs{}
	interactions := &testInteractions{items: map[string]domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction{}}
	readiness := &testReadiness{result: domain.TeacherLearningReadiness{
		Schema: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessSchema, Result: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessNeedsClarification,
		ReasonCodes: []string{domain.TeacherReadinessReasonLearningIntentMissing}, ResolverVersion: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessResolver,
		StateRef:       domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: domain.TeacherReadinessStateNone, Version: 0},
		ReadinessScope: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessScope, ContentStatus: domain.TeacherLearningContentNotCreated,
	}}
	return &Service{
		Teachers: testTeacher{}, Dialogs: dialog, Sources: dialog, StructuredMessages: dialog, PlainMessages: dialog, CanonicalMessages: dialog,
		Students: student, Receipts: store, Interactions: interactions, Readiness: readiness, Handoffs: &testHandoffs{interactions: interactions}, TerminalSessions: &testTerminalSessions{}, IDs: ids, Clock: clock, LeaseTTL: time.Minute,
		CanonicalActionsEnabled: true, UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled: true, ProductAwareEnabled: true, PlannerHandoffEnabled: true,
	}, student, dialog, store
}

func installCollectingInteraction(t *testing.T, service *Service, sessionSchemaVersion int) domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction {
	t.Helper()
	binding := domain.TeacherDialogBinding{ID: testDialogID, StudentID: testStudentID, PersonalTeacherID: testTeacherID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral}
	step := domain.OnboardingStepDirection
	var assistantUI json.RawMessage
	var err error
	if sessionSchemaVersion > 1 {
		step = domain.OnboardingStepGoal
		_, assistantUI, err = domain.BuildProductAwareTeacherOnboardingPrompt(step, "ru", 0)
	} else {
		_, assistantUI, err = domain.BuildTeacherOnboardingPrompt(step, "ru", 0)
	}
	require.NoError(t, err)
	interaction, err := domain.NewS5OnboardingInteractionFromPrompt(binding, domain.DeterministicOnboardingUUID("historical-prompt", sessionSchemaVersion), 1, assistantUI, step, 0, 0, sessionSchemaVersion, service.Clock.Now())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	_, _, err = service.Interactions.EnsureActiveInteraction(context.Background(), interaction)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	return interaction
}

func actionRequest(message string, version int, block, action, key string) domain.AssistantUIActionRequest {
	return domain.AssistantUIActionRequest{Schema: domain.AssistantUIActionSchema, DialogID: testDialogID, MessageID: message, MessageVersion: version, BlockID: block, ActionID: action, IdempotencyKey: key}
}

func sessionPrompt(t *testing.T, session domain.TeacherOnboardingSession) (string, int) {
	t.Helper()
	if session.V3 != nil && session.V3.CurrentPrompt != nil {
		return session.V3.CurrentPrompt.MessageID, session.V3.CurrentPrompt.MessageVersion
	}
	if session.V2 != nil && session.V2.CurrentPrompt != nil {
		return session.V2.CurrentPrompt.MessageID, session.V2.CurrentPrompt.MessageVersion
	}
	require.NotNil(t, session.MessageID)
	require.NotNil(t, session.MessageVersion)
	return *session.MessageID, *session.MessageVersion
}
